_weekly_comment: Groups posted to only on specific weekdays instead of daily (the cron still runs every day; these are skipped on other days). Weekdays may be names (mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun) or ints (Mon=0 .. Sun=6). MUTANDIRI VILLAGE RESIDENTS (120363166672509962@g.us) gets the borehole ad three times a week, on Monday, Wednesday and Friday (matching the building-materials-promo cadence for that group).
